mapper.update: UPDATE kit_job_log SET trigger_time = #{triggerTime}, trigger_code = #{triggerCode}, trigger_msg = #{triggerMsg}, executor_address = #{executorAddress}, executor_handler = #{executorHandler}, executor_param = #{executorParam}, executor_sharding_param = #{executorShardingParam}, executor_fail_retry_count = #{executorFailRetryCount} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT IFNULL(COUNT(handle_code), 0) triggerDayCount, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN (trigger_code IN (0, 200) AND handle_code = 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS triggerDayCountRunning, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN handle_code = 200 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS triggerDayCountSuc FROM kit_job_log WHERE trigger_time BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to}

SELECT COALESCE(COUNT(handle_code), 0) triggerDayCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN (trigger_code IN (0, 200) AND handle_code = 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS triggerDayCountRunning, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN handle_code = 200 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS triggerDayCountSuc FROM kit_job_log WHERE trigger_time BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to}
SELECT id FROM kit_job_log WHERE NOT ( (trigger_code IN (0, 200) AND handle_code = 0) OR (handle_code = 200) ) AND alarm_status = 0 ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT #{pagesize}
